confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Helsinki price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately certain. July accommodation is least certain because summer demand swings rates. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer) rather than direct recall. EUR-to-USD uses an assumed general-knowledge rate, not a live one. The FX value came from search-result summaries that point to RBA pages; I did not directly read the RBA page, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Nordic capitals (Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen), placing Helsinki at the lower end of that group for restaurants and hotels, based on general knowledge rather than live data.
